0.def:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where RemoteIPType == "Public" and ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| project DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, Timestamp
| sort by DeviceName asc, RemoteIP asc, RemotePort asc, Timestamp asc
| extend prev_dev = prev(DeviceName, 1), prev_ip = prev(RemoteIP, 1),
         prev_port = prev(RemotePort, 1), prev_ts = prev(Timestamp, 1)
| where DeviceName == prev_dev and RemoteIP == prev_ip and RemotePort == prev_port
| extend delta_sec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, prev_ts)
| summarize conn_count = count(), avg_delta = avg(delta_sec), stdev_delta = stdev(delta_sec)
    by DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| where conn_count > 30 and avg_delta between (30.0 .. 600.0) and stdev_delta < 5.0
| order by conn_count desc
0.sent:
ImNetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
| where DvcAction != "Block"
| where ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr) == false
| summarize ConnCount = count(),
            DistinctMinutes = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1m))
            by DvcHostname, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber
| where ConnCount > 50 and DistinctMinutes > 30   // sustained, not bursty
| order by ConnCount desc
0.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count, values(All_Traffic.dest_port) AS ports
    from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic
    where All_Traffic.action="allowed" AND All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal"
    by _time span=10s, All_Traffic.src, All_Traffic.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| streamstats current=f last(_time) AS prev_time by src, dest
| eval delta = _time - prev_time
| stats avg(delta) AS avg_delta stdev(delta) AS sd_delta count by src, dest
| where count > 30 AND sd_delta < 5 AND avg_delta>=30 AND avg_delta<=600
| sort - count

1.sigma:
title: Browser Extension Installation via Registry
id: 7c8b2e10-4d4f-4a8c-9c1f-bf6e2c4a8d0a
status: experimental
description: |
    Registry writes under the browser extension policy keys —
    administrative install of an extension. Often used by adware /
    info-stealers to bypass user-level extension controls.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1176/
author: Clankerusecase
date: 2026/05/02
tags:
    - attack.t1176
    - attack.persistence
logsource:
    category: registry_event
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        TargetObject|contains:
            - '\Software\Google\Chrome\Extensions\'
            - '\Software\Microsoft\Edge\Extensions\'
            - '\Software\Mozilla\Firefox\Extensions\'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Group-policy-managed extension whitelists
level: medium
1.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry
    where (Registry.registry_path="*\Software\Google\Chrome\Extensions\*"
        OR Registry.registry_path="*\Software\Microsoft\Edge\Extensions\*"
        OR Registry.registry_path="*\Software\Mozilla\Firefox\Extensions\*")
    by Registry.dest, Registry.registry_path, Registry.registry_value_data, Registry.registry_value_name, Registry.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)`

2.sigma:
title: Infostealer - Non-Browser Process Accessing Browser Credential Stores
id: 7c8b2e10-4d4f-4a8c-9c1f-bf6e2c4a8d01
status: experimental
description: |
    Stealers (RedLine, Lumma, Vidar, Atomic) read Login Data / cookies
    SQLite databases from Chrome/Edge/Firefox profile directories. Any
    non-browser process touching these files is a high-fidelity signal.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1539/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1555/003/
author: Clankerusecase
date: 2026/05/02
tags:
    - attack.t1539
    - attack.t1555.003
    - attack.credential-access
logsource:
    category: file_access
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_path:
        TargetFilename|contains:
            - '\Google\Chrome\User Data\'
            - '\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\'
            - '\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\'
    selection_file:
        TargetFilename|endswith:
            - '\Login Data'
            - '\Cookies'
            - '\logins.json'
            - '\cookies.sqlite'
    filter_browser:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\chrome.exe'
            - '\msedge.exe'
            - '\firefox.exe'
            - '\brave.exe'
            - '\opera.exe'
    condition: selection_path and selection_file and not filter_browser
falsepositives:
    - Backup utilities reading user profile files
    - Browser sync agents from non-stock vendors
level: high
2.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where (Filesystem.file_path="*\Google\Chrome\User Data\*\Login Data*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Google\Chrome\User Data\*\Cookies*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\*\Login Data*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\*\logins.json*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\*\cookies.sqlite*")
      AND NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe")
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.process_name, Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`

30.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/cloudtrail (operators substitute their actual trail name)
# Stage 1: count failed ConsoleLogin attempts per principal+IP, then
# join in your own follow-up query against AssumeRole within a tight
# window (CWLI joins are limited -- use stats over short ranges).
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.userName, sourceIPAddress, errorMessage
| filter (eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and errorMessage = "Failed authentication")
      or (eventName = "AssumeRole" and not isPresent(errorCode))
| stats count(*) as events,
        sum(if(eventName = "ConsoleLogin", 1, 0)) as failed_logins,
        sum(if(eventName = "AssumeRole",   1, 0)) as assume_role_hits
     by userIdentity.userName, sourceIPAddress
| filter failed_logins > 5 and assume_role_hits > 0
| sort events desc

157.sigma:
title: FakeCaptcha / ClickFix - Clipboard-Injected PowerShell from Explorer
id: 7c8b2e10-4d4f-4a8c-9c1f-bf6e2c4a8d06
status: experimental
description: |
    "FakeCaptcha" / "ClickFix" social-engineering: malicious site asks
    user to press Win+R and paste a payload. The result is

    base64 / downloadstring in the command line.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1204/002/
author: Clankerusecase
date: 2026/05/02
tags:
    - attack.t1059.001
    - attack.t1204.002
    - attack.execution
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_parent:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\explorer.exe'
            - '\RuntimeBroker.exe'
    selection_child:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '\mshta.exe'
    selection_cmd:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'iex'
            - 'invoke-expression'
            - 'frombase64'
            - 'downloadstring'
            - 'hxxp'
            - 'curl '
            - 'wget '

157.spl:

    where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe")
      AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe")

158.def:
// Pre-filter each table BEFORE the union — the engine cannot push
// predicates across `union`, and DeviceFileEvents lacks ProcessCommandLine
// (Initiating only) so column-projection has to differ per side.
union
    ( DeviceFileEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
        | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
        | where SHA256 in~ (__HASH_LIST__) or SHA1 in~ (__HASH_LIST__) or MD5 in~ (__HASH_LIST__)
        | project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
                  Cmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Source = "DeviceFileEvents" ),
    ( DeviceProcessEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
        | where AccountName !endswith "$"
        | where SHA256 in~ (__HASH_LIST__) or SHA1 in~ (__HASH_LIST__) or MD5 in~ (__HASH_LIST__)
        | project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
                  Cmd = ProcessCommandLine, Source = "DeviceProcessEvents" )
| order by Timestamp desc
158.sent:
// Pre-filter both ASIM tables before the union — same pattern as the
// Defender version so the engine can push hash predicates per-side.
let BadHashes = dynamic([__HASH_LIST__]);
union
    ( ImFileEvent
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
        | where TargetFileSHA256 in~ (BadHashes)
           or TargetFileSHA1 in~ (BadHashes)
           or TargetFileMD5 in~ (BadHashes)
        | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, EventType,
                  TargetFileName, TargetFilePath, TargetFileSHA256,
                  Cmd = ActingProcessName, Source = "ImFileEvent" ),
    ( ImProcessCreate
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
        | where SHA256 in~ (BadHashes) or SHA1 in~ (BadHashes) or MD5 in~ (BadHashes)

166.def:
// Phishing-link click that drives endpoint execution within 60s.
// Far higher fidelity than "every clicked URL" — most legitimate clicks
// never spawn a non-browser child process, so the join eliminates the
// 99% of noise that makes a raw click query unactionable.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SuspectClicks = UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | join kind=inner (
        EmailEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
        | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
        | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
        | project NetworkMessageId, Subject, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain,
                  RecipientEmailAddress, EmailTimestamp = Timestamp
      ) on NetworkMessageId
    | join kind=leftouter (
        EmailUrlInfo | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
      ) on NetworkMessageId, Url
    | project ClickTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Url, UrlDomain,
              Subject, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, RecipientEmailAddress,
              ActionType;
// Correlate to a non-browser child process spawned within 60 seconds on
// the recipient's device.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe",
                                         "outlook.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe",
                        "rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe",
                        "bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe")
| join kind=inner SuspectClicks on $left.AccountName == $right.AccountUpn
| where Timestamp between (ClickTime .. ClickTime + 60s)
| project ClickTime, ProcessTime = Timestamp,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, ClickTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress,
          Subject, Url, UrlDomain, ActionType,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by ClickTime desc
166.sent:
// UrlClickEvents has no clean Sentinel-native equivalent. The detection
// pivots to: Office Send→Receive proximity to SecurityEvent 4688 of a
// non-browser child process. Lower fidelity than the Defender version.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SuspectMailUsers = OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OfficeWorkload == "Exchange"
    | where Operation =~ "Receive"
    | summarize Subject = any(Subject), Sender = any(Sender)
                by MailboxOwnerUPN, MessageId, EmailTime = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("\chrome.exe","\msedge.exe",
                                     "\firefox.exe","\outlook.exe","\brave.exe")
| where NewProcessName has_any ("\powershell.exe","\pwsh.exe","\cmd.exe",
                                  "\mshta.exe","\rundll32.exe","\regsvr32.exe",
                                  "\wscript.exe","\cscript.exe","\bitsadmin.exe",
                                  "\certutil.exe","\curl.exe","\wget.exe")
| join kind=inner SuspectMailUsers on $left.Account == $right.MailboxOwnerUPN
| where TimeGenerated between (EmailTime .. EmailTime + 60s)
| project TimeGenerated, EmailTime, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, Sender, Subject
| order by TimeGenerated desc
166.spl:
``` Phishing-link click that drives endpoint execution within 60s ```
| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS click_time
    from datamodel=Web
    where Web.action="allowed"
    by Web.src, Web.user, Web.dest, Web.url
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| rename user AS recipient, dest AS clicked_domain, url AS clicked_url
| join type=inner recipient
    [| tstats `summariesonly` count
         from datamodel=Email.All_Email
         where All_Email.action="delivered" AND All_Email.url!="-"
         by All_Email.recipient, All_Email.src_user, All_Email.url, All_Email.subject
     | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Email)`
     | rex field=url "https?://(?<email_domain>[^/]+)"
     | rename recipient AS recipient]
| join type=inner src
    [| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS exec_time
         values(Processes.process) AS exec_cmd, values(Processes.process_name) AS exec_proc
         from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
         where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe",
                                                   "outlook.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe")
           AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe",
                                            "rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe",
                                            "cscript.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe",
                                            "curl.exe","wget.exe")
         by Processes.dest, Processes.user
     | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
     | rename dest AS src]
| eval delta_sec = exec_time - click_time
| where delta_sec >= 0 AND delta_sec <= 60
| table click_time, exec_time, delta_sec, recipient, src, src_user, subject,
        clicked_domain, clicked_url, exec_proc, exec_cmd
| sort - click_time

167.def:
// Safe Links assessed the URL as risky, showed a warning page, and the
// user proceeded anyway. ClickedThrough events are inherently rare —
// every hit deserves analyst review. UrlDomain isn't on UrlClickEvents
// or EmailEvents — it's only on EmailUrlInfo, so we left-outer join it.
UrlClickEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType == "ClickedThrough"
| join kind=leftouter (
    EmailEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | project NetworkMessageId, Subject, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain,
              RecipientEmailAddress, EmailDirection
  ) on NetworkMessageId
| join kind=leftouter (
    EmailUrlInfo
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
  ) on NetworkMessageId, Url
| project Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Url, UrlDomain,
          EmailDirection, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain,
          RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, Workload
| order by Timestamp desc

168.def:
// Click on inbound-email URL where url-domain != sender-domain.
// The sender-domain root and url-domain root are extracted then
// compared; a mismatch on a cheap-TLD url-domain is the high-signal
// case. Tune the legit-marketer allowlist to your environment to
// suppress the residual newsletter / vendor-tracker noise.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let LegitTrackers = dynamic(["mailchimp.com","sendgrid.net","sendgrid.com",
    "constantcontact.com","hubspotlinks.com","hubspot.com","mktoresp.com",
    "marketo.com","pardot.com","exacttarget.com","klaviyomail.com",
    "list-manage.com","createsend1.com","createsend.com","sg.actblue.com",
    "ml-attach.com","emltrk.com","amazonses.com","amazon.com","sndarsffrt.com",
    "salesforce.com","force.com","docusign.net","echosign.com",
    "office365.com","microsoft.com","onmicrosoft.com","linkedin.com",
    "github.com","githubusercontent.com","atlassian.net","jira.com"]);
let CheapTlds = dynamic(["sbs","life","top","icu","cyou","gdn","click","loan",
    "rest","monster","work","cn","ru","tk","ml","cf","ga"]);
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where DeliveryAction == "Delivered" and EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| extend SenderRoot = extract(@"([^.]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, tolower(SenderFromDomain))
| join kind=inner (
    EmailUrlInfo | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
  ) on NetworkMessageId
| join kind=inner (
    UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | project Url, ClickTimestamp = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress
  ) on Url
| extend UrlDomLower = tolower(UrlDomain)
| extend UrlRoot = extract(@"([^.]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, UrlDomLower)
| extend UrlTld = extract(@"\.([a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, UrlDomLower)
| where UrlRoot != SenderRoot
   and UrlRoot !in (LegitTrackers)
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".microsoft.com"
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".office.com"
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".sharepoint.com"
| extend RiskScore = case(UrlTld in (CheapTlds), 3,
                          UrlRoot endswith ".ru" or UrlRoot endswith ".cn", 2,
                          1)
| where RiskScore >= 2
| project ClickTimestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, RecipientEmailAddress,
          SenderFromAddress, SenderRoot, UrlDomain, UrlRoot, UrlTld,
          RiskScore, Subject, Url
| order by RiskScore desc, ClickTimestamp desc

    | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ListeningConnectionCreated")
    | where LocalPort in (EdgePorts)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project EdgeTs = Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, LocalPort,
              EdgeListenProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let PostExploit = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("release_agent","/sys/fs/cgroup","bash -i","sh -i","/dev/tcp/","nc -e","nc.exe -e","reverse shell","python -c","Invoke-Expression","DownloadString","-EncodedCommand"))
         or FileName in~ ("bash","sh","dash","python","python3","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","nc","ncat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe")

    | project PostTs = Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,

| where PostTs between (EdgeTs .. EdgeTs + Window)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', PostTs, EdgeTs)

description: |
  An interactive UI process (browser, explorer/file-manager, terminal emulator)
  spawns a shell or interpreter whose command line carries a one-shot decode/
  download-and-execute pipeline. Joint signature of the ClickFix social-engineering
  technique used to land PamDOORa, Quasar Linux RAT (QLNX) and TCLBANKER this fortnight.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\WindowsTerminal.exe'
      - '\wt.exe'
      - '/Terminal'
      - '/Terminal.app/Contents/MacOS/Terminal'
      - '/gnome-terminal'
      - '/gnome-terminal-server'
      - '/iTerm2'
      - '/konsole'
      - '/xterm'
      - '/Safari'
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/dash'
      - '/osascript'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/perl'
  selection_payload:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'base64 -d'
      - 'base64 --decode'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - ' -enc '
      - 'DownloadString('
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'IEX('
      - 'iwr -useb'
      - 'curl '
      - 'wget '
      - 'do shell script'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_image and selection_payload
falsepositives:
  - IT runbooks where engineers copy install commands from an internal wiki and paste into a terminal
  - Developer one-liners pasted from Stack Overflow during local troubleshooting
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.004
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1140
  - attack.t1105

181.def:
let LookbackPeriod = 7d;
let CorrelationWindow = 5m;
let InterpreterParents = dynamic(["python.exe","python","python3","uvicorn","gunicorn","node.exe","node","nodejs","erl.exe","erl","beam.smp","php-fpm","php-fpm7","php-fpm8","ruby","java.exe","java","dotnet.exe","dotnet"]);
let ShellOrLolbin = dynamic(["sh","bash","dash","zsh","ksh","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","pwsh","curl.exe","curl","wget.exe","wget","nc","ncat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","perl","socat"]);
let SuspectChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackPeriod)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (InterpreterParents)
    | where FileName in~ (ShellOrLolbin)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessTokenElevation !in~ ("TokenElevationTypeFull")
        or InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project ChildTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FolderPath, ChildName = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ChildPid = ProcessId,
              ChildProcessGuid = ProcessUniqueId;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackPeriod)
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, NetInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          NetInitiatorPid = InitiatingProcessId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
| join kind=inner SuspectChildren on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (ChildTime .. ChildTime + CorrelationWindow)
| project ChildTime, NetTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ChildTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage, ParentCmd, ChildImage, ChildName, ChildCmd,
          NetInitiator, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
| order by ChildTime desc

let RunnerPaths = dynamic(["/runners/start","/runners/load-reader","/api/kernels","/stata_do","/workspaces/","/auth/login"]);

    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ConnectionFound","NetworkSignatureInspected")
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (RunnerPaths) or AdditionalFields has_any (RunnerPaths)
    | project NetTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, InboundProcess=InitiatingProcessFileName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node","node.exe","python","python.exe","python3","jupyter-kernel","enterprise_gateway","stata","stata.exe","stata-mp","stata-mp.exe","xstata","xstata.exe","php","php-fpm","php-fpm.exe","w3wp.exe","uvicorn","gunicorn")

| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")

| where Timestamp between (NetTime .. NetTime + Window)

182.sent:
let Window = 2m;
let RunnerPaths = dynamic(["/runners/start","/runners/load-reader","/api/kernels","/stata_do","/workspaces/","/auth/login"]);
let RunnerHits =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (W3CIISLog
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
            | where csMethod == "POST"
            | where csUriStem has_any (RunnerPaths)
            | project NetTime=TimeGenerated, Host=Computer, SrcIP=cIP, ReqUri=csUriStem, UA=csUserAgent),
        (AzureDiagnostics
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
            | where Category in ("ApplicationGatewayAccessLog","FrontDoorAccessLog","AppServiceHTTPLogs")
            | where httpMethod_s == "POST" or CsMethod_s == "POST"
            | extend Uri = coalesce(requestUri_s, csUriStem, originalRequestUriWithArgs_s, "")
            | where Uri has_any (RunnerPaths)
            | project NetTime=TimeGenerated, Host=coalesce(hostname_s, host_s, Resource), SrcIP=coalesce(clientIp_s, ClientIp_s, CIp_s), ReqUri=Uri, UA=coalesce(userAgent_s, csUserAgent,""))
    | where isnotempty(Host);
let Children =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (SecurityEvent
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
            | where EventID == 4688
            | where ParentProcessName has_any ("node.exe","python.exe","php.exe","php-fpm.exe","w3wp.exe","stata.exe","xstata.exe")
            | where NewProcessName has_any ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bash.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","python.exe","perl.exe")
            | project ProcTime=TimeGenerated, Host=Computer, ParentBinary=tostring(split(ParentProcessName,"\\")[-1]), ChildBinary=tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1]), ChildCmd=CommandLine, Account=SubjectUserName),
        (Syslog
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
            | where Facility == "authpriv" or ProcessName in ("audispd","auditd","sshd")
            | where SyslogMessage has_any ("comm=\"sh\"","comm=\"bash\"","comm=\"curl\"","comm=\"wget\"","comm=\"python\"")
            | where SyslogMessage has_any ("node","python","stata","php-fpm","uvicorn","gunicorn")
            | extend ParentBinary=extract(@"pcomm=\"([^\"]+)\"",1,SyslogMessage), ChildBinary=extract(@"comm=\"([^\"]+)\"",1,SyslogMessage), ChildCmd=SyslogMessage, Account=extract(@"uid=(\d+)",1,SyslogMessage)
            | project ProcTime=TimeGenerated, Host=HostName, ParentBinary, ChildBinary, ChildCmd, Account);
Children
| join kind=inner RunnerHits on Host
| where ProcTime between (NetTime .. NetTime + Window)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ProcTime, NetTime)
| project ProcTime, NetTime, DelaySec, Host, SrcIP, ReqUri, UA, ParentBinary, ChildBinary, ChildCmd, Account
| order by ProcTime desc

183.def:
let Window = 10m;
let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","index.docker.io","ghcr.io","crates.io"]);
let PublicDropDomains = dynamic(["workers.dev","trycloudflare.com","web.app","raw.githubusercontent.com","gist.github.com","transfer.sh","ngrok.io","ngrok-free.app","api.telegram.org","discord.com","discordapp.com","pastebin.com","hastebin.com","bot.discord.com"]);
let CredArtifacts = dynamic([".npmrc",".pypirc","credentials",".git-credentials","id_rsa","id_ed25519","config.json",".env","Login Data","Cookies","key4.db","logins.json"]);
let PkgMgrParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","pip","pip.exe","pip3","pip3.exe","uv","uv.exe","poetry","poetry.exe","node.exe","node"]);
let ScriptChildren = dynamic(["node.exe","node","python.exe","python","python3","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash","sh","curl.exe","wget.exe"]);
let PkgInstallStage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrParents)
    | where FileName in~ (ScriptChildren)
    | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("install","add","i ","ci","preinstall","postinstall","lifecycle","build")
    | project InstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              PkgMgr = InitiatingProcessFileName, PkgMgrCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ChildPid = ProcessId;
let CredReadStage = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed") or ActionType startswith "File"
    | where FileName in~ (CredArtifacts) or FolderPath has_any (".aws",".ssh","User Data\\Default",".npm",".config\\gh")
    | project CredTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, CredFile = FolderPath, CredInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName, CredInitiatorPid = InitiatingProcessId;
let EgressStage = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2d)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where not(RemoteUrl has_any (RegistryHosts))
    | extend HitDrop = iff(RemoteUrl has_any (PublicDropDomains), true, false)
    | where HitDrop == true
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, EgressInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName, EgressPid = InitiatingProcessId;
PkgInstallStage
| join kind=inner CredReadStage on DeviceId
| where CredTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + Window)
| join kind=inner EgressStage on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + Window)
| where EgressInitiator in~ (ScriptChildren) or EgressInitiator =~ ChildProc or CredInitiator in~ (ScriptChildren)
| summarize InstallTime = min(InstallTime), CredReads = dcount(CredFile),
            CredFiles = make_set(CredFile, 25), DropDomains = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            DropIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, PkgMgr, ChildProc, ChildCmd
| where CredReads >= 1
| order by InstallTime desc

# log group: /aws/cloudtrail
# Endpoint-side supply-chain stealer detection lives on EDR, not CloudTrail.
# This adjunct flags downstream IAM-credential abuse from a stolen .aws/credentials key:
# console logins / API calls from an unfamiliar IP for an IAM user shortly after the
# fortnight's package-install window. Pair with the endpoint UC for full chain.
fields @timestamp, eventName, eventSource, sourceIPAddress, userAgent, userIdentity.type, userIdentity.userName, userIdentity.arn, awsRegion, errorCode

      and not isPresent(errorCode)
      and (eventName = "ConsoleLogin" or eventName like /^(GetCallerIdentity|ListBuckets|ListUsers|CreateAccessKey|AttachUserPolicy|GetSecretValue|AssumeRole)$/)

      and sourceIPAddress not like /^10\./
      and sourceIPAddress not like /^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\./
      and sourceIPAddress not like /^192\.168\./
| stats count(*) as calls, count_distinct(eventName) as distinctActions, earliest(@timestamp) as first_seen, latest(@timestamp) as last_seen by userIdentity.userName, sourceIPAddress, userAgent
| filter distinctActions >= 2
| sort first_seen desc

    "panlogd","catalina.sh","ws_TomcatService.sh"]);

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OSPlatform in ("Linux","macOS")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_WebServerProcs)
    | where FileName in~ (_ShellChildren)
    | where InitiatingProcessParentFileName !in~ (_AutomationParents)
    | where ProcessCommandLine !has " --version"
        and ProcessCommandLine !has " -V"
        and not(ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bstatus\b")
        and ProcessCommandLine !has "healthcheck"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProc  = FileName,
              ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
              FolderPath, SHA256;
// Corroborating signal — webshell/script drop into a web root by the same kind of service process
let WebshellDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FolderPath has_any (
        @"/mi/tomcat/webapps/", @"/var/www/", @"/usr/share/nginx/html/",
        @"/opt/pan/", @"/var/panlogs/", @"/opt/tomcat/webapps/",
        @"/srv/www/", @"/htdocs/")
    | where FileName endswith ".jsp" or FileName endswith ".jspx"
         or FileName endswith ".php" or FileName endswith ".aspx"
         or FileName endswith ".sh"  or FileName endswith ".py"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_WebServerProcs)
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DroppedFile = FileName, DropPath = FolderPath, DroppedBy = InitiatingProcessFileName;
ShellSpawns

| extend CorroboratingDropMin = iff(isnotempty(DropTime), datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, DropTime), int(null))

status: experimental
description: |
  Detects post-exploit behavior on internet-facing edge appliances and Linux
  servers where a service process (PAN-OS user-id daemons, Ivanti EPMM mifs/tomcat,
  Apache, Nginx, sshd, generic application servers) directly spawns a Unix shell
  interpreter or an ingress-tool LOLBin. Drives off the CVE-2026-0300 (PAN-OS),
  CVE-2026-6973 (Ivanti EPMM), and Linux 'Dirty Frag' zero-day cluster of
  May 2026.

  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/captive-portal-zero-day/

let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowMin = 5m;
let ServerRuntimes = dynamic(["node.exe","node","python.exe","python","python3","java.exe","java","uvicorn.exe","uvicorn","gunicorn","yamcsd","yamcs"]);
let ShellAndLolbins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","dash","zsh","ash","wmic.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","curl.exe","curl","wget.exe","wget","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","nc","ncat","ncat.exe"]);
let ServerPorts = dynamic([80,443,3000,5000,8000,8080,8443,8888,8090,5050,4242]);
let Inbound =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ListeningConnectionCreated","ConnectionAcknowledged")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ServerRuntimes
    | where LocalPort in (ServerPorts) or RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project ConnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              LocalPort, RemoteIP, RemoteIPType,
              RuntimePid = InitiatingProcessId,
              RuntimeName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RuntimeCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let ShellSpawns =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ServerRuntimes
    | where FileName in~ ShellAndLolbins
    | where not (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("uvicorn.exe","uvicorn","gunicorn") and FileName in~ ("python.exe","python","python3"))   // legitimate worker fork
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              RuntimePid = InitiatingProcessId,
              RuntimeName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RuntimeCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildName = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ChildSha256 = SHA256;
ShellSpawns
| join kind=inner Inbound on DeviceId, RuntimePid
| where ProcTime between (ConnTime .. ConnTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ProcTime, ConnTime)
| summarize FirstConn = min(ConnTime), FirstSpawn = min(ProcTime),
            MinDelaySec = min(DelaySec),
            Children = make_set(ChildName, 10), SampleChildCmd = any(ChildCmd),
            ChildHashes = make_set(ChildSha256, 10),
            RemoteIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 10), ListenPorts = make_set(LocalPort, 5),
            SpawnCount = count()
            by DeviceName, AccountName, RuntimeName, RuntimePid, RuntimeCmd
| order by FirstSpawn desc

let LookbackDays = 7d;

let _baseline_parents = dynamic(["systemd","systemd-udevd","udevd","init","kmod","systemd-modules-load","dpkg","apt","apt-get","yum","dnf","zypper","snapd","unattended-upgrade","ansible-playbook","puppet","chef-client","salt-minion"]);

    | where Timestamp > ago(1d)
    | where OSPlatform == "Linux"
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, OSDistribution, IsInternetFacing) by DeviceId, DeviceName;

    | where DeviceId in ((LinuxHosts | project DeviceId))

    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (_suspect_modules)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_baseline_parents)
    | where AccountName !in~ ("root","")
    | project StageOneTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              KmodUser = AccountName,
              KmodCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              KmodParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              KmodParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let RootStage =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DeviceId in ((LinuxHosts | project DeviceId))
    | where AccountName =~ "root"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("root","")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_root_legit_parents)
    | project StageTwoTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              RootProc = FileName,
              RootCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              RootParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RootParentUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
KmodStage
| join kind=inner RootStage on DeviceId

          RootParent, RootProc, RootCmd

title: Suspicious Child Process of npm/yarn/pnpm Install Lifecycle Touching Credentials or Worm Payload Names
id: e6f1d8a4-7c9b-4d3e-a2bd-2026shaihulud
status: experimental
description: Detects an npm/yarn/pnpm/bun/node parent spawning a script interpreter whose command line references developer credential paths or known Mini Shai-Hulud worm payload filenames within node_modules, indicating an install-hook supply-chain compromise.
references:
    - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/bitwarden-cli-hijacked-on-npm-bun-staged-credential-stealer-targets-developers-github-actions-and-ai-tools
    - https://snyk.io/blog/tanstack-npm-packages-compromised/
    - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/mini-shai-hulud-is-back-tanstack-compromised
    - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/node-ipc-npm-supply-chain-attack
    - https://snyk.io/blog/malicious-node-ipc-versions-published-npm/
    - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/popular-node-ipc-npm-package-compromised-to-steal-credentials/
author: detection-engineering (fortnightly synth)
date: 2026-05-17
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.t1195.002
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.007
    - attack.t1059.001
    - attack.credential_access
    - attack.t1552.001
    - attack.t1552.004
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    parent_is_pkg_manager:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\npm.exe'
            - '\npm-cli.js'
            - '\yarn.exe'
            - '\pnpm.exe'
            - '\bun.exe'
            - '\node.exe'
    parent_cmd_is_install:
        ParentCommandLine|contains:
            - 'preinstall'
            - 'postinstall'
            - 'node_modules'
            - 'npm install'
            - 'yarn install'
            - 'pnpm install'
    child_is_interpreter:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '\bash.exe'
            - '\sh.exe'
            - '\wsl.exe'
            - '\bun.exe'
            - '\node.exe'
    child_cmd_targets_creds_or_payload:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '\.ssh\'
            - '\.aws\credentials'
            - '\.aws\config'
            - '.npmrc'
            - '.gitconfig'
            - 'Login Data'
            - 'logins.json'
            - '\.docker\config.json'
            - '\.kube\config'
            - '.env'
            - 'GITHUB_TOKEN'
            - 'router_init.js'
            - 'router_runtime.js'
            - 'tanstack_runner.js'
            - 'vite_setup.mjs'
            - 'bw_setup.js'
            - 'bw1.js'
            - 'node-ipc.cjs'
    condition: child_is_interpreter and (parent_is_pkg_manager or parent_cmd_is_install) and child_cmd_targets_creds_or_payload

    - Internal post-install scripts that legitimately read .npmrc to authenticate to a private registry — pair with allowlist by project path

// Stage 1 — EvilTokens-style: successful device-code or OAuth consent sign-in
let WindowMin = 60m;
let Lookback = 7d;
let ConsentAuth =
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "deviceCode"
         or AuthenticationRequirement =~ "deviceCode"
         or ApplicationId !in~ ("00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000","1fec8e78-bce4-4aaf-ab1b-5451cc387264")
            and isnotempty(ResourceDisplayName)
    | project AuthTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, AccountObjectId, AuthIp = IPAddress,
              AuthCountry = Country, AuthApp = ApplicationDisplayName, SessionId,
              AuthAsn = tostring(NetworkLocationDetails);
// Stage 2 — privileged cloud action from a different IP, ≤60 min later
let PrivAct =
    CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType in~ (
        "Add service principal credentials.",
        "Add owner to application.",
        "Add app role assignment to service principal.",
        "Consent to application.",
        "New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule",
        "Add-MailboxPermission",
        "FileDownloaded","FileSyncDownloadedFull",
        "MailItemsAccessed",
        "Update user.","Add member to role.",
        "Register device.")
    | project ActTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn = AccountDisplayName, ActIp = IPAddress,
              ActCountry = CountryCode, ActionType, ObjectName = ObjectId, RawEventData;
ConsentAuth
| join kind=inner (PrivAct) on AccountUpn
| where ActTime between (AuthTime .. AuthTime + WindowMin)
| where tostring(AuthIp) != tostring(ActIp)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ActTime, AuthTime)
| summarize ActionCount = count(),
            Actions = make_set(ActionType, 25),
            FirstAct = min(ActTime),
            LastAct = max(ActTime),
            DistinctActIps = dcount(ActIp),
            ActIps = make_set(ActIp, 10),
            ActCountries = make_set(ActCountry, 10)
            by AuthTime, AccountUpn, AuthIp, AuthCountry, AuthApp, SessionId
| where ActionCount >= 1   // any single sensitive action from a new IP within 60m is alert-worthy
| order by FirstAct desc
197.sent:
// Sentinel — SigninLogs (device-code / OAuth consent) joined to AuditLogs + OfficeActivity
let WindowMin = 60m;
let Lookback = 7d;
let ConsentAuth =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "deviceCode"
         or tostring(AuthenticationDetails) has "deviceCode"
    | project AuthTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, UserId,
              AuthIp = IPAddress, AuthCountry = LocationDetails.countryOrRegion,
              AuthApp = AppDisplayName, SessionId = CorrelationId;
let PrivAuditAct =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where OperationName in~ (
        "Add service principal credentials",
        "Consent to application",
        "Add owner to application",
        "Add app role assignment grant to user",
        "Update application – Certificates and secrets management",
        "Add member to role",
        "Register device")
    | extend Upn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
             ActIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | project ActTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName = Upn, ActIp,
              ActionType = OperationName, Target = tostring(TargetResources);
let PrivOfficeAct =
    OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where Operation in~ ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","Add-MailboxPermission",
                           "FileDownloaded","FileSyncDownloadedFull","MailItemsAccessed")
    | project ActTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName = UserId,
              ActIp = ClientIP, ActionType = Operation, Target = OfficeObjectId;
let PrivAct = union PrivAuditAct, PrivOfficeAct;
ConsentAuth
| join kind=inner (PrivAct) on UserPrincipalName
| where ActTime between (AuthTime .. AuthTime + WindowMin)
| where tostring(AuthIp) != tostring(ActIp)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ActTime, AuthTime)
| summarize ActionCount = count(),
            Actions = make_set(ActionType, 25),
            FirstAct = min(ActTime),
            LastAct = max(ActTime),
            ActIps = make_set(ActIp, 10)
            by AuthTime, UserPrincipalName, AuthIp, tostring(AuthCountry), AuthApp, SessionId
| order by FirstAct desc

``` Stage 1: device-code or non-Microsoft OAuth consent sign-in success ```
| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS auth_time, values(Authentication.src) AS auth_src_ip, values(Authentication.app) AS auth_app
    from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication
    where Authentication.action="success" AND (Authentication.signature_id="deviceCode" OR Authentication.authentication_method="deviceCode" OR Authentication.signature="Consent to application")
    by Authentication.user, Authentication.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)`
| rename user AS upn, dest AS tenant
``` Stage 2: privileged cloud action from a DIFFERENT src IP within 60 min ```
| join type=inner upn
    [| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS act_time, values(All_Changes.src) AS act_src_ip, values(All_Changes.action) AS act_name, values(All_Changes.object_id) AS act_obj
        from datamodel=Change.All_Changes
        where All_Changes.object_category IN ("user","mailbox","application","role","device")
          AND All_Changes.action IN ("created","modified","granted","added")
          AND All_Changes.result="success"
        by All_Changes.user
     | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)`
     | rename user AS upn]
| where act_time >= auth_time AND act_time <= auth_time + 3600
| where auth_src_ip != act_src_ip
| iplocation auth_src_ip prefix=auth_
| iplocation act_src_ip prefix=act_
| where auth_Country != act_Country OR isnull(act_Country)
| eval delay_min = round((act_time - auth_time)/60, 1)
| table auth_time, act_time, delay_min, upn, tenant, auth_src_ip, auth_Country, act_src_ip, act_Country, act_name, act_obj, auth_app
| sort 0 - act_time

let PkgManagers = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","npm-cli.js","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","composer.exe","composer","composer.phar","pip.exe","pip","pip3","makepkg","pacman","yay","paru","bun.exe","bun","poetry"]);

          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession
| order by Timestamp desc

let Lookback = 7d;
let Window = 5m;
let PkgInstallParents = dynamic(["node.exe","npm.cmd","yarn.cmd","pnpm.cmd","npx.cmd","code.exe","msiexec.exe","setup.exe","installer.exe"]);
let LifecycleCues = dynamic(["preinstall","postinstall","npm install","yarn install","pnpm install","npm-cli.js","yarn.js","pnpm.cjs"]);
let CredArtefacts = dynamic([".npmrc",".aws\\credentials",".aws/credentials",".ssh\\id_",".ssh/id_",".env","/proc/","environ","Login Data","Cookies","GITHUB_TOKEN","NPM_TOKEN","ANTHROPIC_API_KEY","HF_TOKEN","aws_access_key","aws_secret",".netrc",".docker\\config",".docker/config","libsecret","find-generic-password"]);
let KnownRegistries = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","npmjs.com","yarnpkg.com","pnpm.io","github.com","githubusercontent.com","vscode-cdn.net","microsoft.com","windows.net","googleapis.com","amazonaws.com","azure.com","docker.io","docker.com"]);
let CredReads = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgInstallParents)
        or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (LifecycleCues)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (CredArtefacts)
        or FolderPath has_any (CredArtefacts)
        or FileName in~ ("env","printenv","security","keychain","strings","xxd")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
        and AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project CredTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let BaselineDomains = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(Lookback))
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | summarize HostCount = dcount(DeviceId) by RemoteUrl
    | where HostCount > 3;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where not(RemoteUrl has_any (KnownRegistries))
    | join kind=leftanti BaselineDomains on RemoteUrl
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, EgressImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
CredReads
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (CredTime .. CredTime + Window)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, CredTime)
| project CredTime, NetTime, DelaySec,
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage, ParentCmd, ChildImage, ChildCmd,
          EgressImage, EgressCmd, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by CredTime desc

let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","repo.packagist.org","packagist.org"]);
let InstallSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrParents))
         or (InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (PkgMgrCmdHints))
    | where FileName in~ (SuspChildren)
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("oven-sh/bun","releases/download","raw.githubusercontent.com","curl -s","wget -q","Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SpawnTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)

    | project EgressTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,

title: Package Manager Lifecycle Hook Spawns Shell or Network Fetcher
id: 8d4f3a9c-7e21-4c8a-9b6e-1f9a2c3e4d5b
status: experimental
description: >

date: 2026-05-24

logsource:

detection:
  parent_pkg_manager:

      - '/python3'
      - '/pip'
      - '/pip3'

    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'npm install'
      - 'npm ci'
      - 'yarn install'
      - 'pnpm install'
      - 'pip install'
      - 'composer install'
      - 'composer require'
      - 'preinstall'
      - 'postinstall'
      - 'lifecycle'

    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\bun.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'

    CommandLine|contains:

      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'curl -s'

let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CorrelationWindowSec = 300;
let PkgMgrParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","npm","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","pip.exe","pip","pip3","pip3.exe","cargo.exe","cargo","nuget.exe","nuget","dotnet.exe","dotnet","composer","composer.phar","gem","bundle","node.exe","node"]);

let HookRuntimes = dynamic(["node.exe","node","python.exe","python","python3","python3.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash","dash","bun.exe","bun","curl.exe","curl","wget.exe","wget","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let RegistryAllow = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","crates.io","static.crates.io","api.nuget.org","nuget.org","www.nuget.org","rubygems.org","packagist.org","repo.packagist.org","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","gitlab.com","bitbucket.org"]);
let HookSpawns =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrParents))
         or (InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (PkgMgrCmdHints))
    | where FileName in~ (HookRuntimes)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProc   = FileName,
              ChildPid    = ProcessId;
let Egress =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in~ ("ConnectionSuccess","ConnectionAttempted","ConnectionFound","DnsConnectionInspected")
    | extend Host = tolower(coalesce(RemoteUrl, ""))
    | where Host == "" or not(RegistryAllow has_any (split(Host, ".")))
    | where not(Host has_any (RegistryAllow))
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort,
              NetInitProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              NetInitCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              NetInitPid  = InitiatingProcessId;
HookSpawns
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + CorrelationWindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ProcTime)
| where DelaySec >= 0 and DelaySec <= CorrelationWindowSec
| where (NetInitProc =~ ChildProc) or (NetInitPid == ChildPid) or (NetInitProc in~ (HookRuntimes))
| summarize FirstSeen = min(ProcTime), LastEgress = max(NetTime),
            EgressCount = count(),
            DistinctDests = dcount(coalesce(RemoteUrl, tostring(RemoteIP))),
            Destinations = make_set(coalesce(RemoteUrl, tostring(RemoteIP)), 25),
            Ports = make_set(RemotePort, 10),

            SampleChildCmd  = any(ChildCmd),
            MinDelaySec = min(DelaySec)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage, ChildImage, ChildProc
| where DistinctDests >= 1
| order by FirstSeen desc

let PkgMgrs = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","npm-cli.js","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","pip.exe","pip","pip3","python.exe","python","python3","composer","composer.phar","node.exe","node"]);

let CodeHostHosts = dynamic(["github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","gist.github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com"]);
let Installs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName in~ (PkgMgrs)) or (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrs))
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (" install"," add "," ci "," require ","postinstall","preinstall","pip install","-r requirements","-c \"import","composer require","npm i ")
    | project InstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              InstallProc = FileName, InstallParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InstallCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let Fetches = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (Fetchers)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (CodeHostHosts)
         or RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)/releases/download/|/raw/|/archive/refs/"
         or isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | project FetchTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              FetcherProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              FetcherCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;

    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(LookbackHours))
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | summarize OrgHosts = dcount(DeviceId) by RemoteUrl
    | where OrgHosts > 5;

| where FetchTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FetchTime, InstallTime)
| join kind=leftanti BaselineDomains on RemoteUrl   // rare-by-org OR codehost (codehost retained below)
| extend IsCodeHost = RemoteUrl has_any (CodeHostHosts)
                  or RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)/releases/download/|/raw/|/archive/refs/"
| where IsCodeHost or DelaySec <= 60   // codehost = high signal at any delay; first-seen domain = tight window
| project InstallTime, FetchTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,

          FetcherProc, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, IsCodeHost
| order by InstallTime desc

// Best-effort hunt — DeviceNetworkEvents only sees URLs on inspected HTTP traffic; HTTPS surfaces SNI only. Pair with web-access logs in Sentinel for full coverage.
let WindowMin = 10m;
let LowPrivPatterns = dynamic(["user_register","/register","onboard-customer","/peering","/auth/login","/login.action","/api/v1/auth","/sessions/new"]);
let AdminPatterns   = dynamic(["/admin","/api/admin","data[access][admin]","data%5Baccess%5D%5Badmin%5D","data[groups]","data%5Bgroups%5D","/configuration","authorized_keys","/installer","/vmanage","/system/setting"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| extend stage = case(
    RemoteUrl has_any (LowPrivPatterns), "low_priv",
    RemoteUrl has_any (AdminPatterns),   "admin",
    "other")
| where stage in ("low_priv","admin")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName, stage
| order by RemoteIP asc, Timestamp asc
| serialize
| extend PrevStage=prev(stage), PrevTime=prev(Timestamp), PrevUrl=prev(RemoteUrl), PrevIP=prev(RemoteIP)
| where stage == "admin" and PrevStage == "low_priv" and RemoteIP == PrevIP
| where datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, PrevTime) <= 10
| project AdminEventTime=Timestamp, LowPrivEventTime=PrevTime,
          DeltaMinutes=datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, PrevTime),

| order by AdminEventTime desc

let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CorrelationWindow = 5m;     // empirical: legitimate post-install fetches usually complete in <5m, beyond that the parent/child PID linkage gets noisy
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["node.exe","npm.cmd","npx.cmd","yarn.cmd","python.exe","python3.exe","ruby.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash.exe","wsl.exe"]);
let EdgeDomains = dynamic([".workers.dev",".trycloudflare.com",".supabase.co",".pages.dev",".web.app",".r2.dev",".vercel.app",".replit.app",".glitch.me",".onrender.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","gist.githubusercontent.com","bitbucket.org/raw"]);
let InstallHints = dynamic(["preinstall","postinstall","install.js","setup.py","pip install","npm install","yarn add","gem install","cargo install"]);
let ProcStart = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ScriptHost  = FileName,
              ScriptCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
              ProcSHA256  = SHA256,
              ProcId      = ProcessId,
              IsRemoteSession = IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (EdgeDomains)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              EgressProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressProcId = InitiatingProcessId;
ProcStart
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId, $left.ProcId == $right.EgressProcId
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + CorrelationWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ProcTime)
| extend InstallContext = iff(ParentCmd has_any (InstallHints) or ScriptCmd has_any (InstallHints), "install-hook", "runtime")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(ProcTime), LastSeen = max(NetTime), HitCount = count(),
            DistinctDomains = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            SampleScriptCmd = any(ScriptCmd),
            SampleParentCmd = any(ParentCmd),
            arg_min(DelaySec, *)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, ScriptHost, InstallContext
| order by FirstSeen desc

// Self-hosted niche service spawns shell/ssh/interpreter within 120s of inbound API listener hit
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 120;
let VulnerableServiceParents = dynamic([
  "nezha","nezha-dashboard","kopia","kopia.exe","kopia-ui","kopia-ui.exe",
  "algernon","filebrowser","fission-router","fission-bundle","boxlite",

  "httpd","apache2","node","node.exe","python","python3","python.exe"
]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic([
  "sh","bash","dash","zsh","ash","ssh","ssh.exe",
  "cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe",
  "perl","ruby","curl","wget","nc","ncat","socat"
]);
let ListenerPorts = dynamic([80,443,2222,3000,4242,5000,8000,8080,8081,8443,8888,9000,9090]);
let WebShellChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) in (VulnerableServiceParents)
  | where tolower(FileName) in (SuspiciousChildren)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-dev" and InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-test"
  | where AccountName !endswith "$"
  | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("healthcheck","--version","/healthz"))
  | extend ChildTime = Timestamp,
           VulnService = InitiatingProcessFileName,
           ChildBin    = FileName,
           ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
           ParentPid   = InitiatingProcessId
  | project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ChildTime, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ParentPid,
           InitiatingProcessFolderPath, FolderPath, SHA256;
let InboundHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ConnectionInbound","ListeningConnectionCreated")
  | where LocalPort in (ListenerPorts) or RemotePort in (ListenerPorts)
  | extend InboundTime = Timestamp,
           RemoteSrc   = tostring(RemoteIP),
           ListenerPort = coalesce(LocalPort, RemotePort)
  | project DeviceId, InboundTime, RemoteSrc, ListenerPort, InitiatingProcessFileName;
WebShellChildren
| join kind=inner InboundHits on DeviceId
| where InboundTime between (ChildTime - WindowSec * 1s .. ChildTime + 5s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, InboundTime)
| summarize FirstInbound = min(InboundTime),
            DistinctSrcIps = dcount(RemoteSrc),

| where DelaySec between (0 .. WindowSec)
| project ChildTime, DeviceName, AccountName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd,

let VulnApiPaths = dynamic([
  "/api/v1/cron","/api/v1/repo/exists","/fission-function/",
  "/public/api/resources","BazaR","vue=formulaire","handler.lua"]);
let ChildSpawns = SecurityEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
  | where EventID == 4688
  | extend ParentBase = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])),
           ChildBase  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1]))
  | where ParentBase in (VulnerableServiceParents)

           ChildBin = ChildBase,
           ChildCmd = CommandLine
  | project Computer, SubjectUserName, ChildTime, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, NewProcessId;
let WebHits = union isfuzzy=true
  (W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where csMethod in ("POST","PATCH","PUT")
    | where csUriStem has_any (VulnApiPaths)
    | extend Computer = sComputerName, InboundTime = TimeGenerated, RemoteSrc = cIP, ApiPath = csUriStem),
  (Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where SyslogMessage has_any (VulnApiPaths)
    | where SyslogMessage has_any ("POST ","PATCH ","PUT ")
    | extend Computer = HostName, InboundTime = TimeGenerated,
             RemoteSrc = extract(@"(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)", 1, SyslogMessage),
             ApiPath  = extract(@"\"(?:POST|PATCH|PUT)\s+(\S+)", 1, SyslogMessage))
  | project Computer, InboundTime, RemoteSrc, ApiPath;

title: Service-Tier Parent Spawns Subprocess With Argv-Injection Or Interpreter-Flag Tokens
id: 7c3a9e1b-4d52-46f0-9a3d-2026w21-argvinj
status: experimental
description: Detects a long-running service / non-interactive tool spawning ssh, git, curl, wget, a shell, powershell, python or perl with command-line tokens characteristic of CLI argument injection or interpreter-driven RCE following web-app or local-tool exploitation (joint pattern across CVE-2026-9082, CVE-2026-26980, CVE-2026-46670, CVE-2026-46633, CVE-2026-45697, CVE-2026-45288, CVE-2026-22599, CVE-2026-45695, CVE-2026-44790, CVE-2026-45369, CVE-2026-45374).

  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-33p6-5jxp-p3x4
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-72w5-pf8h-xfp4

      - '\cmd.exe'

    CommandLine|contains:

      - '--upload-pack='
      - '--receive-pack='
      - 'core.sshCommand'
      - '--exec='
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -ec '
      - '$('
      - '/dev/tcp/'
      - 'bash -i'
      - 'nc -e'
      - 'base64 -d'
      - '--config '

let CorrelationMinutes = 60;
let PrivilegedRoles = dynamic(["owner","admin","administrator","global administrator","globaladministrator","privileged role administrator","application administrator","cloud application administrator","superuser","super admin","root"]);

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType has_any ("Add member","Add user","Add owner","Add role","Update role","Assign role","Add member to role","Add owner to group","Add member to group")
         or RawEventData has_any ("\"role\":\"owner\"","\"role\":\"admin\"","\"role\":\"Owner\"","\"role\":\"Administrator\"","AdministratorAccess")
    | extend RawJ = parse_json(RawEventData)
    | extend GrantedRole = tolower(tostring(coalesce(RawJ.role, RawJ.RoleAdded, RawJ.NewRole, RawJ.new_role, RawJ["target_role"])))
    | extend GranteeId = tostring(coalesce(RawJ.user_id, RawJ.TargetUserId, RawJ.targetUserPrincipalName, RawJ.target, RawJ["member"]))
    | extend GrantorId = tostring(coalesce(AccountObjectId, RawJ.actor_id, RawJ.actorPrincipalId))
    | where isnotempty(GrantedRole) and isnotempty(GranteeId) and isnotempty(GrantorId)
    | where GrantedRole in (PrivilegedRoles)

    | project GrantTime = Timestamp, GrantorId, GrantorIP = IPAddress, GranteeId, GrantedRole,

    union isfuzzy=true
        (SigninLogs
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(_Lookback) | where ResultType == 0
            | extend Principal = UserPrincipalName, PrincipalId = UserId, AppKind = "User"),
        (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(_Lookback) | where ResultType == 0
            | extend Principal = UserPrincipalName, PrincipalId = UserId, AppKind = "NonInteractive"),

    | project SignInTime = TimeGenerated, Principal, PrincipalId, AppDisplayName, AppId, AuthIP = IPAddress, AppKind
    | join kind=leftanti _BaselinePairs on AppId, $left.AuthIP == $right.IPAddress;

title: Web Server / App Server Process Spawning Shell or Recon Utility
id: 8b3f0b4c-5d2e-4d96-b1a4-9e1b2d3c4a52
status: experimental
description: Detects web-server or app-server processes (IIS w3wp, Apache/httpd, nginx, php-fpm/php-cgi, Java/Tomcat, node) spawning interactive shells, scripting hosts, or download/recon utilities. High-fidelity post-exploit anchor for plugin/extension RCE chains (Grav Direct Install, Portainer Docker plugin endpoints, WordPress Burst/Avada/Funnel Builder, Checkmarx Jenkins AST plugin, cPanel Filemanager backdoor).
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1190/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1505/003/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent_selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\nginx.exe'
      - '\php-cgi.exe'
      - '\php.exe'
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\javaw.exe'
      - '\tomcat.exe'
      - '\node.exe'
      - '/httpd'
      - '/apache2'
      - '/nginx'
      - '/php-fpm'
      - '/java'
      - '/node'
  child_selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\ncat.exe'
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/perl'
      - '/ruby'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/whoami'
      - '/id'
      - '/uname'
      - '/nc'
  condition: parent_selection and child_selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate web-app deployment scripts triggered as the web-server account by CI/CD
  - Healthcheck or self-update routines that legitimately shell out (uncommon)
  - Web-based admin consoles that run remote commands by design (Webmin, Cockpit) — exclude by hostname

  - attack.initial_access

```
Normalize command variations to base command types to count distinct reconnaissance categories.
For example, "show running-config", "show running-config | include username", and "show running-config interface" all count as one command type.
This prevents adversaries from evading detection by adding arguments or using multiple variations of the same command.
```

| eval command_type=case(
    match(command, "^show access-list"), "show access-list",
    match(command, "^show conn"), "show conn",
    match(command, "^show cpu"), "show cpu",
    match(command, "^show crypto"), "show crypto",
    match(command, "^show eigrp"), "show eigrp",
    match(command, "^show failover"), "show failover",
    match(command, "^show flow"), "show flow",
    match(command, "^show interface"), "show interface",
    match(command, "^show inventory"), "show inventory",
    match(command, "^show ip"), "show ip",
    match(command, "^show license"), "show license",
    match(command, "^show memory"), "show memory",
    match(command, "^show nat"), "show nat",
    match(command, "^show ospf"), "show ospf",
    match(command, "^show process"), "show process",
    match(command, "^show running-config"), "show running-config",
    match(command, "^show startup-config"), "show startup-config",
    match(command, "^show version"), "show version",
    match(command, "^show vpn-sessiondb"), "show vpn-sessiondb",
    match(command, "^show xlate"), "show xlate",
    true(), command)

| bin _time span=5m

| stats count
        earliest(_time) as firstTime
        latest(_time) as lastTime
        dc(command_type) as unique_recon_commands
        values(command_type) as command_types
        values(command) as commands
        values(src_ip) as src_ip

  by _time host user

| where unique_recon_commands >= 7

`cisco_ios`
facility IN ("HA_EM", "VMAN", "IM", "AAA")

message_text IN (

    "*IOX SERVICE guestshell*",
    "*Destroying virtual service 'guestshell*",

| eval dest=coalesce(host, dvc, dest, "unknown")
| eval event_type=case(
    like(message_text, "%guestshell enable%"), "guestshell_enable_command",
    like(message_text, "%guestshell destroy%"), "guestshell_destroy_command",
    like(message_text, "%Successfully activated virtual service 'guestshell%"), "vman_guestshell_activated",
    like(message_text, "%IOX SERVICE guestshell%"), "im_iox_guestshell_activated",
    like(message_text, "%Destroying virtual service 'guestshell%"), "vman_guestshell_destroying",
    like(message_text, "%Successfully destroyed virtual service 'guestshell%"), "vman_guestshell_destroyed",
    true(), "other"
)
| bin _time span=30m
| stats count min(_time) as firstTime
              max(_time) as lastTime
              values(event_type) as event_types
              values(message_text) as message
by _time dest
| where
        (
            mvfind(event_types, "vman_guestshell_activated") >= 0
            OR
            mvfind(event_types, "im_iox_guestshell_activated") >= 0
            OR
            mvfind(event_types, "guestshell_enable_command") >= 0
        )
        AND
        (
            mvfind(event_types, "vman_guestshell_destroying") >= 0

`cisco_ios`
facility IN ("AAA", "HA_EM")
mnemonic IN ("AAA_ACCOUNTING_MESSAGE", "LOG")
message_text IN (
    "*show running-config*",
    "*show tacacs*",
    "*show cdp neighbors*",
    "*show file systems*",
    "*dir bootflash:*",
    "*show clock*",
    "*show platform software status control-processor brief*",
    "*terminal length 0*",
    "*terminal width 0*"
)

| rex field=message_text "^\w+:(?<aaa_src>[^:@]+)(?:@[^:]*)?:(?<aaa_user>[^:]*):(?<aaa_command>.*?)(?:\s+\((?<aaa_result>SUCCESS|FAILURE)\))?$"
| rex field=message_text "^(?:[^:]+:\s+)?(?:catchall:\s+)?(?<eem_command>.+?)\s*$"
| eval command=lower(trim(coalesce(aaa_command, eem_command, "")))

| eval command_type=case(
    like(command, "show running-config%"), "show_conf",
    like(command, "show tacacs%"), "show_tacacs",
    like(command, "show cdp neighbors detail%"), "show_cdp",
    like(command, "show cdp neighbors%"), "show_cdp",
    like(command, "show file systems%"), "show_file",
    like(command, "dir bootflash:%"), "dir_bootflash",
    like(command, "show clock%"), "show_clock",
    like(command, "show platform software status control-processor brief%"), "show_platform",
    like(command, "terminal length 0%"), "terminal",
    like(command, "terminal width 0%"), "terminal",
    true(), null())
| where isnotnull(command_type)
| eval user=coalesce(aaa_user, user, "unknown")
| eval src_ip=coalesce(aaa_src, src_ip, "unknown")
| eval dest=coalesce(host, dvc, dest, "unknown")
| bin _time span=5m
| stats count min(_time) as firstTime
              max(_time) as lastTime
              dc(command_type) as unique_recon_commands
              values(command_type) as command_types
              values(command) as commands
  by _time dest user src_ip
| where unique_recon_commands >= 4
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `cisco_ios_xe_reconnaissance_command_activity_filter`
